NO GIMMICKS, NO FLEUX GIVEN We believe a watch should be more than just an accessory - it should be an expression of character, integrity and design philosophy. With our last three releases we’ve explored our interpretation on the very best of dive watch design and this release marks the final chapter in our Skin Diver series. True design doesn’t need to shout. It doesn’t rely on excess or trend-driven embellishments. Instead, it thrives in restraint, proportion, and intention. This is simplicity at its more deliberate. A watch for those who appreciate precision over clout, subtlety over spectacle. In a world where loud branding, trendy clashing colours, and 100 dial elements dominate, the FLX004 is a contrarian design study for those who eschew substance over excess. The question we’re asking here is - would you rather broadcast what you’re wearing because everyone else has one or be noticed by the few who appreciate details? Details over Displays. Design over Distraction. No Gimmicks. #NOFLEUXGIVEN

watches.description: ** U.S. CUSTOMERS - Please read our update on tariffs here. THE HISTORY The Omega Seamaster 300 Big Triangle has its origins in the 1960s when it was commissioned by the British Ministry of Defence (MOD) for military use. The MOD required a reliable, highly legible dive watch for its personnel, and the Seamaster 300 was selected for its robust design and exceptional underwater performance. The distinctive "Big Triangle' at 12 o'clock was introduced to ensure that time could be read quickly and accurately, even in low-light conditions. This feature made the SM300BT a trusted tool for military divers and became an iconic design element that is still celebrated today. So let's celebrate the Big Triangle with a... Big Triangle (BT). THE FLX003 With the FLX003, we've preserved the essence of this iconic watch, while incorporating subtle changes that enhance the original design - chief among them, new broad arrow hands. Like the big triangle, the broad arrow hands were an MOD design specification made to reflect military heritage and enhanced readability. The BT dial and broad arrow hands are housed within our rugged skin diver 316L case, along with the useful yet rare countdown bezel. Designed as a reliable tool for both diving and everyday wear, the Fleux FLX003 is more than just a watch; it's our nod to a piece of horological history, designed for those who appreciate the legacy of the Seamaster 300 and its role in military and diving history.

watches.name: FLEUX - FLX002
watches.description: * WINNER of the 2023 Good Design ® Award by the Chicago Athenaeum ( - founded in 1950 by Charles and Ray Eames, Eero Saarinen, and Edgar Kaufmann, Jr.) ** VERY LIMITED QUANTITIES REMAIN . (Secure yours today as they will never be reproduced.) The Archetypal Skin Diver Case The classic lugs curve downwards to hug the wrist, ensuring a comfortable fit throughout the day while the tool-proportioned lugs have been slightly thinned from the classic 1970s design, striking the perfect balance between tool and dress watch. The case also features a combination of circular brushing and polished chamfers which although subtle, ensure the watch to be versatile enough to be used on your next dive or desk diving adventure. The Dial With a combination of Roman and Arabic numerals, the FLX002 dial is the classic " California Dial ". Not only is this 1930s design still relevant today, it is thought to have been designed to ensure high visibility and error-proof reading. The Strap All FLEUX watches come equipped with a strap made from a recycle ocean plastic material called SEAQUAL , with a soft water resistant nubuck lining made for comfort. Our straps are also made with quick release spring bars because we know you have tons of straps and we wanted to make your life easier. ( Although the straps are water-resistant, we do not advise you to go swimming or diving with them .)
